jobs.description:
**Company:** ForkTalent  
**Position:** Full Stack AI Developer  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years (Freshers with strong projects are welcome)  
**Work Mode:** Remote  
**Location:**Mumbai

About ForkTalent

ForkTalent is an AI-powered recruitment and interview platform designed to transform how companies screen and evaluate candidates.

We help recruitment teams streamline initial screening through AI-driven interviews, intelligent question generation, structured candidate evaluations, and automated interview workflows.

Our platform offers AI-generated, employer-defined, and hybrid interview experiences, along with recorded sessions and detailed evaluation reports.

We are building technology that helps companies make recruitment more efficient, structured, and scalable.

Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated **Full Stack AI Developer** who is passionate about building scalable web applications and integrating modern AI technologies into real-world products.

You will work across the frontend, backend, databases, and AI integration layers to develop and improve ForkTalent's core platform.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving engineering challenges, experimenting with LLMs, building intelligent workflows, and taking ownership of product features from development to deployment.

Key Responsibilities

**Full Stack Development**

* Develop and maintain responsive, scalable web applications.
* Build interactive frontend interfaces
